rationale: Methylphenidate and modafinil were assigned after pediatric CNS cancer therapy. Napping and sleep-related endpoints pertain to the drugs; the study arms contain no potato or carrot. Registry results present for the drug trial.
N-acetyl-L-leucine and its control are the assigned interventions for ataxia-telangiectasia. Dysarthria contributes to an ataxia assessment; milk, tarragon and clove were not assigned.

0794: Three oven-baked potato preparations and a deep-fried potato preparation are compared with baked cauliflower tots and no side in healthy adults. The secondary acute subjective-emotion composite includes a sleepiness item. No separately assigned boiled potato or daytime sleep-disorder endpoint. 0808: No carrot arm. Recruiting protocol.

0794: Two daily servings of potato chips versus pistachios for 30 days in midlife women, with a same-coaching snack comparison and an additional sleep-coaching arm. The primary outcome is PSQI; secondary measures include PROMIS Sleep Related Impairment, specifically daytime interference from sleepiness, PVT and ISI. Potato chips leave preparation transfer to boiled potato unresolved. 0715/0681/0726/0808: No assigned almond oil, toasted nigella, corn oil or raw carrot. Recruiting protocol.
MTBVAC versus BCG in South African neonates assesses vaccine safety and immunogenicity. No target food comparison was identified in the registered arms.

Pediatric meal crossover assigns mashed potatoes, French fries, hash browns, rice, beans and meal skipping with acute subjective sleepiness among repeated secondary mood ratings. The registry does not specify boiling the mash or supply a sleepiness result. Lee et al. PMID 30844296 matches the six-arm design and reports mashed potatoes prepared fresh, frozen and microwaved; its abstract does not present sleepiness results. Full Methods and item-level result remain a follow-up.

Metabotype-tailored polyphenol diet versus control. Registered secondary descriptions include sleep and mood instruments. Potatoes appear in Mediterranean diet score component descriptions; potato, raw carrot, corn oil and Sichuan pepper are not individually assigned interventions in the screened record.

0794: Experiment 2 assigns oven-baked potatoes and fries or deep-fried fries versus baked cauliflower tots or no side in healthy adults. Sleepiness contributes to a secondary acute emotion composite; the next-morning secondary sleep-quality measure uses a five-item VAS. No boiled-potato arm. 0726/0808: No assigned corn oil or carrot. Recruiting protocol.

0600: Daily two-month post-COVID odor training explicitly includes dill with ten other odors, versus no training. Primary Taste and Smell Survey and secondary Sniffin' Sticks; dill form and separate exposure effect unavailable. 0592: No summer savory in the listed series. No results posted on the registry.

Single whole-food comparison of blueberries versus dried dates in older adults. Orthostatic hypotension, sleep and incontinence appear among endpoints; ground cumin, raw kale, brown rice and corn oil are outside the assigned exposure.

The long-COVID intervention is oxaloacetate versus white rice flour; the primary Chalder fatigue scale and secondary global change/up-time endpoints differ from orthostatic lightheadedness. Orthostatic intolerance describes long COVID. No steamed brown rice.

0726: US Army personnel receive Lovaza or three 1 g corn-oil placebo capsules daily for 3 months. PSQI and ESS are primary psychometric battery components. Refining is unspecified and the registered contrast estimates fish oil versus the comparator. Status UNKNOWN, last update 2011-03-09; no registry results. Dretsch et al. PMID 24690964 is a plausible follow-up but reports corn-oil ethyl esters and outcomes at 60 days, with exact accession linkage and between-arm PSQI/ESS results unresolved. 0794/0808/0707: sleepiness and Zung depression measures do not add a matching food arm.

Diet crossover allocates rapeseed oil, butter and coconut oil in prepared blinded meals. Co-primary total cholesterol and hs-CRP, with cardiometabolic and microbiota measures, establish a different clinical question. No levodopa dyskinesia or daily OFF.

0762: Canola is half the mixed lipid component of an energy-matched control against ketone monoester; no levodopa dyskinesia outcome. 0726: Other half is corn oil and control also includes fructose. PSQI and sleep-disturbance scores are secondary during five days of older-adult bed rest. Corn oil effect and refining unspecified; no registry results.

Mediterranean-diet counseling permits olive or canola oil in a multicomponent assignment versus low-fat diet. Primary metabolic syndrome and secondary psychological well-being concern the intervention as a whole. No tested boiled-potato/sleepiness, canola/dyskinesia or Sichuan pepper/depression comparison.

Canola oil is 7 g per 100 g in the standard control therapeutic food formula. Infants and children with severe acute malnutrition are compared on developmental and malnutrition response outcomes. No levodopa dyskinesia outcome.

Mixed meals use combinations of carbohydrate foods including potato and rapeseed oil as a high-fat food. Registered glycemic and insulinemic responses concern meal composition. No daytime sleepiness or levodopa dyskinesia outcome.
Canola oil substitutes for the MCT additive in an asthma nutrition comparison. The registered primary outcome is maintaining MCT tolerance in asthma. No levodopa dyskinesia outcome.

Canola-oil capsules serve as omega-3 placebo in a folate/omega-3 factorial trial of older depressed adults receiving vitamin B12. Depressive symptoms are the primary outcome. No Sichuan pepper or levodopa dyskinesia outcome.
Rapeseed-oil emulsion appears in the rationale for isotopic lipid tracers. The intervention compares octanoic acid and trioctanoin breath tests of gastric emptying. No levodopa dyskinesia outcome.

Three-dose AEF0117 versus corn-oil placebo in treatment-seeking cannabis use disorder. The MOS Sleep Scale characterizes sleep quality as an Other outcome. Corn-oil refining and independent oil effect unavailable. No structured registry results; the separate phase 2b sponsor disclosure gives end-of-treatment MOS-SS 355.4 ± 5.31 with corn-oil placebo and 364.2 ± 5.2 with AEF0117 1 mg (p=.24).

Shift workers are assigned a diet with about 50 g/day canola oil or standard dietary advice. Primary metabolic measures and secondary melatonin address the shift-work/metabolic question. No levodopa dyskinesia outcome.

Microencapsulated rapeseed oil is part of an active multicomponent nutrition product in hepatic steatosis. Weight, satiety, hunger and tolerability are registered outcomes. No levodopa dyskinesia outcome.
Rapeseed fat emulsion versus isocaloric carbohydrate drink in healthy-weight and obese participants assesses MRI appetite/satiety pathways. No levodopa dyskinesia outcome.

Prediabetes diet trial compares canola-supplemented keto, butter/coconut-oil keto and a low-fat whole-grain pattern that may include brown rice. The primary comparison is plasma triglycerides. No orthostatic, dyskinesia or daily OFF endpoint.

Rapeseed and hazelnut oils are named unsaturated-fat sources within Mediterranean diet guidance. The obesity trial measures satisfaction and eating behavior. No isolated cold-pressed oil comparison, levodopa dyskinesia or vocal loudness.
Rapeseed oil and soy-protein diets are examined in familial hypercholesterolemia with blood lipid and related biomarkers. No levodopa dyskinesia outcome.

0613: Curcuma longa rhizome extract is among multiple herbal and vitamin ingredients in an anti-hangover formula; d2 measures cognitive performance, without handwriting measurement. 0808: Placebo is 100 mL carrot juice one hour before alcohol. Acute hangover symptom descriptions include fatigue/weakness and list sleepiness in background, without specifically registering a sleepiness scale or assigning raw whole carrot.

Canola oil is a non-ketogenic placebo against a ketone ester. Primary frailty composite and cognition, mood and sleep assessments do not add a levodopa dyskinesia outcome, corn-oil intervention or Sichuan pepper intervention.

0762: The Japanese nurse trial crosses stress management with omega-3/placebo. Placebo contains rapeseed, soybean, olive and fish oils. The matched word “aims” occurs in the PRIME-MD description; outcome measures are HADS and other mental-health instruments, without an involuntary-movement scale. 0726/0707: Sleep and mood terms do not add corn oil or Sichuan pepper. No registry results.

Very preterm infants receive massage with a mixture containing 57% rapeseed oil or massage without oil. Primary Prechtl spontaneous-movement repertoire is a developmental measure rather than levodopa-induced dyskinesia.

0726: In head and neck cancer radiotherapy, 5 mL/day pigmented/flavored corn oil versus omega-3 is added to enteral diet. EORTC QLQ-C30 contains an insomnia item, but registered primary outcomes are its global health and physical functioning subscales. No item result posted; study terminated and refining unspecified. 0591: Constipation is also in the questionnaire, without an assigned chive exposure.

0726: Five-day corn-oil capsule placebo versus AEF0117 in cannabis use disorder. Sleep quality and quantity are secondary. Haney et al. 10.1038/s41591-023-02381-w links this accession and reports sleep in Extended Data Figs. 7–8; actigraphy had overall treatment effects on snooze time (p=.0071) and wake bouts (p=.0237), and subjective waking often had a dose-by-treatment interaction with neither dose differing from placebo. Haney Methods identify the same pharmaceutical-grade corn oil in active and placebo capsules, so the allocation tests the drug on a common oil vehicle. 0715/0681: Attention testing does not add almond oil or toasted nigella exposure.

A multicomponent Mediterranean diet program supplies canola oil and healthy snacks in pregnancy. Adherence, gestational weight, cardiometabolic and obstetric outcomes define the comparison; “aims” in the descriptions is an ordinary verb, without a dyskinesia scale. Registry results posted for this trial.
Acute older-adult mixed meals compare 25 or 50 g of canola and coconut oil, with metabolic and cognitive measurement. No Parkinson group, levodopa dyskinesia or diary OFF-time measure.
Canola oil, margarine and other whole-diet changes are part of a healthy-diet arm stratified by genotype. Primary liver fat addresses the liver question. No levodopa dyskinesia outcome.

Canola is the assigned control for long-chain PUFA supplementation in autistic children. The registered primary autism behavior composite and related measures are independent of levodopa dyskinesia. Registry results posted.

Older adults receive 3 × 1.1 g daily corn-oil placebo capsules or omega-3 for 14 weeks, with resistance training in both groups. PSQI is registered under Other outcomes. Corn oil refining unspecified; no posted results. Dalle et al. PMID 33284965 matches ethics ID S61809, 23 participants and the exercise protocol. PSQI results were not located in the full body or seven-page original supplement.

0726: Adults with psychological distress received 400 mg/day corn-oil placebo or omega-3 for 3 months. The primary battery includes PSQI and ESS. The registry posts a favorable summary without structured results and was first posted after completion; corresponding Azhar et al. PMID 41461240 was retracted for major data and analysis discrepancies, PMID 42469048. 0794/0808/0707: Sleepiness and PHQ-9 measures have no matching potato, carrot or Sichuan pepper arm.
Fortified canola oil versus fortified sunflower oil in adults with type 2 diabetes measures serum glucose and HbA1c. No levodopa dyskinesia outcome.

Sichuan pepper is one named ingredient of the traditional multicomponent external acupoint plaster for pelvic pain. Primary abdominal pain VAS and secondary EQ-5D anxiety/depression dimension do not isolate depression severity. No oral toasted Sichuan pepper arm or Parkinson population; recruiting without posted results.
